definitions.explanation: A substance used to prevent or eliminate pests, insects, or plant diseases, especially in agriculture and gardening.

examples.japanese: {畑|はたけ}に{防除剤|ぼうじょざい}をまく。
examples.english: to spread pest-control agent on the field.

examples.japanese: この{防除剤|ぼうじょざい}は{害虫|がいちゅう}によく{効|き}く。
examples.english: This pesticide works well against harmful insects.

examples.japanese: {農薬|のうやく}の{使|つか}いすぎを{避|さ}けるため、{防除剤|ぼうじょざい}の{量|りょう}を{減|へ}らした。
examples.english: To avoid overusing agrochemicals, I reduced the amount of pest-control agent.

notes:
Composed of {防除|ぼうじょ} ('prevention and extermination') + {剤|ざい} ('agent, preparation'). Refers to substances used to control agricultural pests, insects, and plant diseases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防除剤|ぼうじょざい}を{散布|さんぷ}する: to spray a pest-control agent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {殺虫剤|さっちゅうざい}: insecticide — targets insects specifically
- {農薬|のうやく}: agricultural chemical — the broader category
